card.name: Words just before a group of people
card.fires_on: Verbs, prepositions and articles that come right before a noun for a group of people, such as the people, travelers, candidate, helpers or children. The next word is expected to name a person or group other than a patient or customer.

modes.label: Verb before people
modes.description: A verb of protecting, communicating or wanting that is followed by a group of people as its object.
modes.example: failed to take reasonable steps to<< protect>> the people on the premises

modes.label: Small word before a person noun
modes.description: An article, preposition or possessive that comes just before a role noun such as candidate, identifier, helpers or children.
modes.example: Store buprenorphine-containing medications safely out of the sight and reach<< of>> children

card.writes: It pushes toward generic words for people such as participants and individuals, and away from patient and customer.
card.plain: It fires on the word just before a general group of people is named, and it steers the next word away from patient or customer.
